title: Battle of Detern
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Detern", at revision 1370438709, opens: "The Battle of Detern on 27 September 1426 marked the prelude to the East Frisian rebellion against the rule of the tom Brok family over East Frisia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q328768, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1426 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
